source_review.notes: Checked all eight references for identity, date, authority, and scope. Fowler and Humble/Farley support the two-environment preparation and traffic-switching pattern. Current RFC 9199 supports DNS TTL transition delay; RFC 8767 supports exceptional stale serving; RFC 9110 supports durable HTTP semantics without being used to claim implementation-specific draining. Current AWS RDS guidance is explicitly limited to vendor evidence about green writes and replication-compatible schema changes. Google SRE and Nygard support release, capacity, and stability reasoning. Checked 2026-09-06.
